instruction: How much money have I sent to others on venmo this month so far?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so the model has no mutating actions besides login. The answer is obtained by filtering Venmo transactions with direction='sent' and created_at within the current month (2023-05-01 up to the current datetime 2023-05-18T12:00:00) and summing their amounts; the sum is represented by the single amount object `sent-total-this-month`, whose value is computed at runtime (paginating show_transactions as needed) and passed as the `answer` to supervisor.complete_task. The venmo username is the supervisor's email; the password comes from show_account_passwords.
